feat(post): wire_edm and sinker_edm machine kinds and the .mch edm section

Two declared-only machine kinds for the EDM family (#290 D1): wire
(X/Y, U/V for taper) and sinker (Z). The .mch file gains an optional
`edm` section - guide planes, max taper, wire diameters, AWT; orbit
patterns with the control's word, max orbit radius, pickup - absent
keys not stated, garbled ones refusing the file, the law restated in
is_sane for project files. No op family admits an EDM, and posting now
re-checks every op's family against its own setup's machine, so an op
made on a mill no longer posts after its setup is remounted onto steel
that cannot run it. Empty wire/sinker templates ship (no vendor
values), kept out of the picker until an EDM op exists.

Pinned by edm_machine (7 tests).

Fixes #530

feat(post): EDM condition table as user data in the .mch edm section

`edm.conditions[]`: the control's condition id, a name, the spark gap
per side, the wire diameter (wire) or electrode undersize (sinker), a
rough/skim/finish role and notes - the geometry a toolpath needs, never
the generator physics. Ids are required and unique, lengths scale with
the file's unit, a garbled entry refuses the file by its id, and
is_sane restates it for project files. Edm::condition(machine, id, need)
is the door an EDM op calls at command creation: a missing condition or
an unstated field it needs is refused by name. No conditions ship.

Pinned by edm_conditions (6 tests).

Fixes #531

feat(edm): sinker burn to depth with a single electrode

A sinker electrode tool kind (ToolKind::Electrode): diameter = face X,
width = face Y, flute_len = length below the holder, shank_len = pickup
offset; rpm 0 and a sharp face by law, refused by name at AddTool /
ChangeTool / the library reader. EDM-E10X6 joins the starter catalog.

The Sinker Burn op (OpType 41, Section::Sinker, Family::Sinker) runs on
a sinker EDM only - refused by name elsewhere. Depth is read from a
stated datum (work top, cavity floor stand-off, electrode tip at the
approach plane); a burn past the cavity floor datum, past the model's
floor, or deeper than the electrode is long is refused by name. The
machine condition's spark gap (#531, Gap only, after the sinker-kind
check) places the tip one gap above the floor. CL: approach rapid, one
feed plunge, rapid retract; golden tests/golden/sinker_burn_cavity.cl.

Verification (#290 D7): the column engine's box atom (simulate_box)
sweeps the face grown by the gap; the program verdict convicts a burn
deeper than the part's cavity. The field eye refuses an electrode by
name (no box atom there yet). The stamp digests the resolved gap.
MCP drives it through add_tool / add_operation / edit_operation /
generate / undo; a minimal op page keeps the tab law. No post (#542).

Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #541

feat(edm): sinker rough and finish with undersize from their conditions

A Sinker Burn now states its pass (single / rough / finish) and the
finished cavity size. A rough or finish reads its condition's undersize
and gap: the electrode must be the size the condition calls for, a burn
wider than the cavity is refused (past the wall), a finish that burns
short of it is refused ("leaves the cavity under size"), and the tip
stands one undersize above the finished floor. A finish whose undersize
is not smaller than the rough it follows is warned by name
(SinkerFinishOrder, advisory). The program verdict's box atom sees the
pair reach the finished size; the pair's CL is golden.

Fixes #543

feat(edm): generic ISO-style sinker post, every EDM code from the machine's edm.codes

assets/posts/sinker-iso.cps ("Sinker EDM (ISO)") writes the RS-274
words itself (G0, G90, the work offset, comments) and every EDM code
from the .mch edm.codes / edm.orbits (#290 D5): the unit word, pickup
{tool}, reference {offset}, condition {id}, the burn to depth {z} {f},
the end, and a stated orbit's word {radius}. A missing code, an unfilled
placeholder or a value the program does not state refuses the post by
name. A feed with X/Y travel, a feed up, an arc, a cycle, compensation,
an rpm or a coolant ask is refused by name.

edm.codes is parsed as role -> non-empty template (garbage refuses the
file by role). The mirror and the raw door carry a wire/sinker machine's
kind and edm section into the script. The engine's serves law: a script
declaring serves = "sinker_edm" posts for sinkers only, and a wire or
sinker EDM refuses every script that does not declare its kind - so
every mill, lathe and plasma post stays refused on a sinker, for the
app, the CLI and user scripts alike. post_serves / default_post_for list
it for sinker EDMs. A Sinker Burn's stream carries PARAM EdmCondition
and ElectrodePickup.

Goldens nc/sinker-iso/ against the synthetic fixture dialect
crates/app/tests/edm/sinker-iso-dialect.mch: the recorded CL posted
from the post crate, and the real op through post_setup. Docs:
assets/posts/AGENTS.md, assets/machines/AGENTS.md, CNC-INTERMEDIATE.
PROCESS_VERSION 23 (renumbers at merge). Follow-up: #1135.

Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #542

generates the real Sinker Burn op on a sinker over a block whose cavity
is the electrode grown by the gap, proves its program is the CL golden
byte for byte, and runs stock_sim::simulate_document (the program
verdict with the electrode's box atom): 0 gouge cells. A 5 mm cavity
convicts 432 cells (checked by hand), so the judge bites. No law loosened.

fix(ui): the Machine window's EDM problems follow #560's condition law

condition_refusal (id spelling, gap > 0, undersize in (0, 1] mm), compares
ids as the loader does (case and leading zeros ignored), and names a
wire-only field on a sinker. Ticking a gap / undersize seeds 0.01 / 0.1 mm
(values the loader accepts) instead of 0. Add condition skips ids that
collide by the loader's key. post exports condition_refusal and
condition_id_key for it.
